items.distractor_fact: Stasiun cuaca di desa tetangga mencatat {D} pada pagi yang sama.
items.gloss_en: The weather station in the neighboring village recorded {D} that same morning.
items.entity_note: a different village's own weather station, not the afternoon/morning readings of the city the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Saham perusahaan lain di bursa yang sama ditutup pada {D} hari itu.
items.gloss_en: Another company's stock on the same exchange closed at {D} that day.
items.entity_note: a different company's stock, not the opening/closing price of the company the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Permukaan air danau lain di kecamatan sebelah tercatat {D} pada musim yang sama.
items.gloss_en: The water level of another lake in the neighboring district was recorded at {D} in the same season.
items.entity_note: a different lake in a different district, not this lake's before/after readings

items.distractor_fact: Ketinggian terbang drone lain yang diterbangkan hari itu tercatat {D}.
items.gloss_en: The flying altitude of another drone flown that day was recorded at {D}.
items.entity_note: a different drone, not this drone's first/second logged readings

items.distractor_fact: Berat badan atlet lain di tim yang sama tercatat {D} pada pemeriksaan itu.
items.gloss_en: The body weight of another athlete on the same team was recorded at {D} at that check.
items.entity_note: a different athlete, not this athlete's start-of-season/end-of-season readings

items.distractor_fact: Kecepatan mobil balap lain di lintasan yang sama terbaca {D} pada putaran itu.
items.gloss_en: The speed of another race car on the same track read {D} on that lap.
items.entity_note: a different race car, not this car's first-lap/last-lap readings

items.distractor_fact: Adiknya memiliki uang saku sebesar {D} minggu itu.
items.gloss_en: His/her younger sibling had pocket money of {D} that week.
items.entity_note: a different child (the sibling), not this child's own pocket money and spending

items.distractor_fact: Nasabah lain di bank yang sama menyetor {D} ke rekeningnya bulan itu.
items.gloss_en: Another customer at the same bank deposited {D} into their account that month.
items.entity_note: a different customer, not this customer's deposit/withdrawal figures

items.distractor_fact: Usaha kecil lain di pasar yang sama memperoleh pemasukan sebesar {D} bulan itu.
items.gloss_en: Another small business at the same market earned income of {D} that month.
items.entity_note: a different business, not this business's income/expenses

items.distractor_fact: Tim lain di liga yang sama mencetak {D} gol sepanjang musim itu.
items.gloss_en: Another team in the same league scored {D} goals that season.
items.entity_note: a different football team, not this team's goals scored/conceded

items.distractor_fact: Pegolf lain di lapangan yang berbeda menyelesaikan permainannya dengan {D} pukulan pada hari yang sama.
items.gloss_en: Another golfer, on a different course, finished their round with {D} strokes that same day.
items.entity_note: a different golfer on a different course whose par is not stated, so it cannot pair with this hole's par

items.distractor_fact: Kereta lain pada jalur yang berbeda tiba di stasiunnya pada menit {D} pagi itu.
items.gloss_en: Another train, on a different line, arrived at its station at minute {D} that same morning.
items.entity_note: a different train on a different line, with no schedule stated for it, so it cannot pair with this train's schedule minute

items.distractor_fact: Kamar hotel lain di gedung yang berbeda berada di lantai {D}.
items.gloss_en: A room in a different hotel building is on floor {D}.
items.entity_note: a room in an entirely different hotel building, whose own lobby/reference floor is not stated, so it cannot pair with this hotel's lobby floor
